pages.title: Stag-Moose
pages.text: The stag-moose ($(o)Cervalces scotti$()) is an extinct deer that lived in North America during the Late Pleistocene, disappearing around 11,000 years ago.$(br2)About the size of a modern moose, it had longer legs and a narrower, elk-like head.$(br2)Males bore elaborate palmate antlers with more branching than those of the moose, and the species favoured wetlands, bogs and the edges of spruce forests.
